title: Long Wing T-Tail Sailplane
description: One original static low-poly unpowered sailplane exterior: a newly lofted slender continuous fuselage and tapered tail boom, long progressively tapered thick wings with modest upward geometry, a high T-tail, a continuous closed nose without a propeller, and a fixed opaque canopy region sharing the fuselage surface topology. One centerline landing wheel, its axle and two finite forks, plus a tail skid strut and finite ground shoe support the fixed display pose. Every separate wing, tail and landing member has a finite geometric connection. One complete aircraft counts as one prop. Eleven editable closed meshes and four opaque constant PBR materials; no texture, animation, tow equipment, cockpit interior, people or airport scene. Metres, native Z up, nose/front -Y, origin X=Y=0 at ground level. Static visual geometry only. No flight, aerodynamic lift or glide ratio, control or landing-gear movement, cockpit access, occupant fit, balance, ground stability, structural load, manufacturing dimensions, airworthiness or aviation safety certification. No compatibility with earlier towbar or parking assets is claimed.
